Sign in with existing credentials. Use this instead of Sign Up if user already exists.
Upload a PDF resume. Skills are extracted and normalized automatically. Unmatched skills are added to taxonomy with 'Others' category.
Retrieve the user's resume data including skills, work experience, projects, and education.

Update skill proficiency levels. Use skill IDs from the GET /profile/skills response. Valid levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced, expert.
Get complete user profile including bio, goals, preferences, and embeddings status.

request.description: Complete profile with bio, goals, experience level, and availability preferences. This triggers async embedding generation.
Get peer match recommendations based on skills, goals, experience, and availability. Results are cached for 1 hour.

request.description: Analyze skill frequencies from user-pasted job descriptions. Paste 3-10 job descriptions from Indeed, LinkedIn, etc. Results cached for 7 days.
When no job descriptions provided, falls back to Phase 1 taxonomy (59 curated skills with demand frequencies).
Update job analysis with new descriptions. Clears cache and re-analyzes.
Clear cached job market analysis for a specific goal. Next request will re-analyze.

exec: console.log('\n⏳ Learning path is being generated...');

request.description: Analyze skill gaps by comparing user skills vs job market data. Requires Feature 1 (job market analysis) to be run first. Triggers async learning path generation.

console.log('Run POST /api/gaps/analyze first, then wait 10-15 seconds');

request.description: Retrieve generated learning path for a goal. Returns 404 if path not generated yet (wait 10-15 seconds after gap analysis).
Regenerate learning path after user adds new skills. Increments version number. Synchronous operation (takes 15-30 seconds).
Check if the API is running and healthy.

request.description: Search skills taxonomy by name or alias. Returns skill IDs needed for adding skills to profile.
Get all skills in taxonomy, optionally filtered by category. Useful for dropdowns.

request.description: Get peer match candidates. Shows pending requests as badge. Filters out: existing connections, dislikes, recent skips (7 days).

exec: console.log('❌ Failed to send connection:', pm.response.json());

request.description: Send connection request to a candidate. Types: mentorship, project_partner, study_partner, general. Invalidates both users' match caches.
Hide user permanently. They won't appear in future matches. Cannot be undone.
Skip user for now. They'll reappear in matches after 7 days.

query.description: received (pending requests), sent (your pending requests), accepted (active connections)

request.description: List connections. Filter by type: received (inbox), sent (waiting), accepted (active). Each shows full profile.
Get full details of a specific connection request or active connection.

exec: console.log('You can now send messages to this user');

request.description: Accept a pending connection request. Sender gets notification. Both can now message each other.
Reject a pending connection request. Sender is notified. User can reappear in your matches later.
Cancel a pending connection request you sent. Only sender can cancel. Receiver will see user in matches again.
Get connection summary: pending_received (inbox count), pending_sent (waiting for response), accepted (active), total.

exec: console.log('❌ Failed to send message:', pm.response.json());

request.description: Send a message (1-5000 chars). Only works in accepted connections. Receiver gets notification immediately.
Get message history. Auto-marks messages as read. Cursor-based pagination using 'before' parameter.
Manually mark all unread messages in this connection as read.

query.description: If true, returns unread count per connection

request.description: Get total unread message count. Use for badge on message icon. Poll every 10-30 seconds.
Get notifications. Types: connection_request, connection_accepted, new_message. Includes related_user profile data.

exec: if (count > 0) console.log('Show badge on notification icon');

request.description: Get unread notification count. Poll every 30-60 seconds to show badge.
Mark single notification as read.
Bulk mark all unread notifications as read.
Delete a notification.
First-time sync or manual re-sync of LeetCode profile. Set force=true to clear cache.
Get cached profile with smart sync. Auto re-syncs if >24h old.
Re-analyze patterns without re-fetching profile. Use after solving new problems.
Find users with complementary skills (your weaknesses = their strengths).
